hero.heroPara: The Occupational English Test (OET) is the leading international English language assessment specifically engineered for healthcare professionals, evaluating medical communication skills across realistic clinical workplace scenarios.

stats.label: Delivery Formats
stats.value: On Paper, On Computer, at Home (OET@Home)

overview: The Occupational English Test (OET) is an international English language assessment tailored exclusively for 12 healthcare professions, including Medicine, Nursing, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, and Radiography.
Unlike general English proficiency exams, OET uses authentic healthcare scenarios to evaluate communication skills directly relevant to clinical practice, hospital wards, and patient consultations.
OET is recognized by major healthcare regulatory councils, hospital trusts, medical councils, and immigration authorities in the UK, USA, Australia, Canada, Ireland, and New Zealand.

sections.name: Listening
sections.measures: Understanding spoken consultations, patient-doctor dialogues, and clinical lectures across three parts: Part A (consultation extracts), Part B (workplace dialogues), and Part C (presentation extracts).

sections.name: Reading
sections.measures: Comprehending health-related texts and clinical literature across three parts: Part A (expeditious reading/matching across 4 short medical texts), Part B (workplace memos/protocols), and Part C (long analytical articles).

sections.name: Writing
sections.measures: Drafting a professional healthcare communication based on clinical case notes—typically a referral letter, transfer letter, or discharge letter tailored to the recipient's role.

sections.name: Speaking
sections.measures: Delivering two recorded clinical role-plays with an interlocutor acting as a patient or caregiver, assessing clinical communication, empathy, reassurance, and professional language accuracy.

scoringSystem: OET scores are reported on a scale of 0 to 500 for each of the four subtests, mapped to letter grades: Grade A (450–500: Very high fluency), Grade B (350–440: High fluency), Grade C+ (300–340), Grade C (200–290), Grade D (100–190), Grade E (0–90). Most healthcare councils (e.g. GMC, NMC in the UK, NMBI in Ireland) require Grade B (350+) in all four subtests.
registrationSteps: Visit the official OET booking portal (oet.com).
Create your profile and enter your personal and contact information accurately.
Select your healthcare discipline (e.g. Medicine, Nursing, Dentistry, Pharmacy).
Choose your preferred test format: OET on Paper, OET on Computer at a test venue, or OET@Home where eligible.
Browse and select an available test date, time, and authorized test city.
Enter your valid passport or authorized national ID information.
Complete the payment using a recognized international credit card.
Check your booking confirmation email and download test-day instructions.
Prepare using profession-specific official mock practice tests and clinical communication materials.
validityDetails: OET score release depends on the provider's official schedule (typically 12–16 days). Scores are valid for two years for healthcare council registration, overseas fellowship training, and medical visa applications.

faqs.q: Why do healthcare professionals choose OET?
faqs.a: OET uses authentic clinical scenarios that healthcare professionals encounter daily, making preparation directly relevant to clinical practice compared to general academic topics.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to take the OET exam in India?
faqs.a: Qualified healthcare professionals and students in 12 covered professions (Medicine, Nursing, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Dietetics, Occupational Therapy, Optometry, Podiatry, Radiography, Speech Pathology, Veterinary Science) are eligible.

faqs.q: What is the OET score needed to work overseas?
faqs.a: Most medical and nursing regulators (such as the UK General Medical Council and Nursing and Midwifery Council) require a minimum Grade B (score of 350 or higher) in each of the four subtests.

faqs.q: How much does the OET exam cost in India?
faqs.a: The exam registration fee is set in Australian Dollars at AU $587 (approximately ₹32,000 depending on current exchange rates and transaction charges).

faqs.q: Is OET better than IELTS for medical professionals?
faqs.a: Neither test is universally superior, but healthcare professionals often feel more confident with OET because the vocabulary, case notes, and speaking role-plays reflect everyday hospital and clinic environments.

countryContexts.uk: In the UK, OET is recognized by the General Medical Council (GMC) for doctor registration (PLAB exemption routes) and the Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) for nurse registration.
countryContexts.ireland: In Ireland, the Medical Council of Ireland and the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) accept OET Grade B for medical registration.
countryContexts.usa: In the USA, ECFMG (Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates) accepts OET Medicine scores for clinical communication certification.
countryContexts.australia: In Australia, AHPRA (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency) recognizes OET across all healthcare boards.
